question: With regard to the hematopoietic progenitor transplant, point out the FALSE statement:

options.opa: In patients who lack an identical or unrelated HLA-identical donor, umbilical cord blood can be used as an alternative source.
options.opb: In patients lacking a familiar or unrelated HLA-identical donor, progenitor cells from a haploidentical donor can be used.
options.opc: In autologous transplantation the cells are cryopreserved and must be thawed prior to administration.
options.opd: The graft effect against leukemia is greater in autologous than in allogeneic transplantation.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "In patients who lack an identical or unrelated HLA-identical donor, umbilical cord blood can be used as an alternative source" -> TRUE -> 100% CHAIN: "In patients lacking a familiar or unrelated HLA-identical donor, progenitor cells from a haploidentical donor can be used" -> TRUE -> 100% CHAIN: "In autologous transplantation the cells are cryopreserved and must be thawed prior to administration" -> TRUE -> 100% CHAIN: "The graft effect against leukemia is greater in autologous than in allogeneic transplantation" -> FALSE -> 100%
analysis: The statement 'The graft effect against leukemia is greater in autologous than in allogeneic transplantation' is FALSE. In fact, allogeneic transplantation has a stronger graft-versus-leukemia effect due to the donor immune cells attacking the leukemia cells.
